title: A call at three in the morning
description: The kitchen is shut, and it is shut at three in the morning on every day of
the week, which is why this scenario can name a time and not a date.
create_order checks the hours itself rather than trusting the agent to have
called check_availability first. Without that check, a call at three books
an order for lunch, tells the caller it will be forty-five minutes, and
leaves a ticket the kitchen finds when it opens.
caller: It is the middle of the night. You are hungry and you want a burger and chips
for collection. Your name is Sam Iversen and your number is 07700 900190.
If you are told they are closed, ask what time they open.

calls.note: Even with everything else right, a shut kitchen refuses.

criteria.name: Said it was closed and when it opens
goal: The agent told the caller the restaurant was closed and gave them the next time it
opens, rather than taking the order or giving a wait time.

criteria.name: Did not take the order anyway
goal: The agent did not give out an order number or say the order had been placed.
